title: Primitive capability probe matrix
claims: The controlled primitive probe writes and reads back arc, circle, dimension, line, polyline, rectangle-linework, and text entities.
The report verifies created handle coverage, layer scope, type counts, and bounding box.
cannot_claim: This does not prove arbitrary annotation styles, formal-layer drafting standards, or project DWG delivery.
The rectangle row is represented by controlled linework in the probe, not a separate AutoCAD rectangle entity.
Hatch is intentionally excluded here and remains covered by the separate RCAD-06 showcase.
